verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26513536 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318730 dated 2026-09-08. It has one line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, quantity 5,500 at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-10-09. Terms are EXW Boise with payment NET30. The document has no corrections or handwriting.
red_flags: The delivery terms are inconsistent. The document states EXW Boise and says DDP is not agreed. It also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. That means the Seller pays and re-invoices costs that normally sit with the buyer under EXW. Check this against the Sales Agreement.
The document has no issue date. Only the customer order date (2026-09-08) is shown.
The quantity is 5,500 units. No total price is given.
observations: The document is a clean, typed one-page PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The description wraps across three lines in the table. All text is legible.
The unit of measure for the quantity is not stated.
